headlines.description: — Travis Bazzana hit a three-run homer, Brayan Rocchio drove in two runs, and the Cleveland Guardians outlasted the Baltimore Orioles 9-5 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bazzana's 3-run homer, Rocchio's 2 RBIs lift Guardians past Orioles 9-5

headlines.description: — Christian Walker, Cam Smith and Daulton Varsho homered and led the Houston Astros to a 6-5 win over the Philadelphia Phillies on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Walker, Smith, Varsho homers power Astros to 6-5 win over the Phillies

headlines.description: — Kody Clemens hit a two-run homer in the sixth inning against his former team and the Minnesota Twins beat the Detroit Tigers 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kody Clemens homers as Twins beat slumping Tigers, 3-2

events.name: New York Mets at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Sean Manaea retired his first 15 batters, Francisco Lindor and Juan Soto homered early and the New York Mets beat the Miami Marlins 7-5 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manaea perfect for 5 innings, Lindor and Soto homer as the Mets beat the Marlins 7-5

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Reid Detmers struck out nine and allowed one hit over six shutout innings, Zach Neto was 4 for 5 with a two-run homer, and the Los Angeles Angels beat the Red Sox 6-1 on Tuesday night to end Boston's five-game win streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reid Detmers strikes out 9 as Angels beat Red Sox 6-1, ending Boston’s streak

events.name: Colorado Rockies at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Aaron Judge went hitless in his return from the injured list but Cam Schlittler struck out 10 in seven sharp innings as the New York Yankees beat the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Judge hitless in return but Yankees clinch 34th straight winning season with 5-3 win over Rockies

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Junior Caminero hit his 39th home run, one of four homers by Tampa Bay, and the Rays beat the Atlanta Braves 7-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Junior Caminero hits his 39th homer as the Rays beat the Braves 7-1

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Corbin Burnes made his return after a 15-month recovery from Tommy John surgery, Lourdes Gurriel Jr. hit a go-ahead RBI triple, and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Kansas City Royals 5-3 in 11 innings on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Diamondbacks beat Royals 5-3 in 11 innings as Corbin Burnes makes return after Tommy John surgery

headlines.description: — Luis Lara singled home the winning run in the 10th inning after Jackson Chourio tied the score with a two-out homer in the ninth, and the Milwaukee Brewers rallied to beat the Chicago Cubs 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lara's single in 10th gives Brewers 4-3 win over Cubs after Chourio's tying homer in 9th

events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Bubba Chandler pitched six strong innings, Rafael Flores Jr. homered among his three hits and the Pittsburgh Pirates pounded the Chicago White Sox 9-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pirates back Bubba Chandler with 18 hits in 9-3 victory over White Sox

headlines.description: — Corey Seager, Wyatt Langford, and Danny Jansen each hit a home run, Cal Quantrill worked six strong innings, and the Texas Rangers got past the Seattle Mariners 10-5 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seager, Langford and Jansen homer to lift Rangers over Mariners 10-5

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Kazuma Okamoto and Josh Smith hit home runs, José Soriano worked seven innings of two-run ball, and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the Athletics 4-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Okamoto and Smith hit homers to help Blue Jays down Athletics 4-2

events.name: Washington Nationals at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Manny Machado tied the score with a two-run single in the eighth inning, Luis Campusano drove in the go-ahead run and the San Diego Padres rallied past the slumping Washington Nationals 5-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Machado and Campusano rally Padres past skidding Nationals 5-4 to keep pace in NL wild-card chase

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Bryce Eldridge hit a solo home run in the first inning and extended his on-base streak to 17 games, Christian Koss connected the next inning, and the San Francisco Giants beat the St. Louis Cardinals 2-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Home runs by Bryce Eldridge, Christian Koss lead Giants past Cardinals 2-1

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Tarik Skubal pitched into the eighth inning, Teoscar Hernández singled home the go-ahead run in the fifth and the Los Angeles Dodgers held off the Cincinnati Reds 3-2 on Tuesday night for their sixth consecutive victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tarik Skubal pitches the Dodgers past the Reds 3-2 for their 6th straight win
